purpose: Drive Cap plus Prism from the current scaffold to verified RedCap revival 1.0 without turning plans, shards, reports, ledgers, or receipts into completion.

driver.cycle_state_authority: this contract is guidance and queue state; lifecycle packets and verified runtime changes are authoritative for each item

cycle_budget.hard_stop: if two consecutive cycles produce only documents, extraction summaries, reports, ledgers, receipts, closeout artifacts, or closure artifacts, stop and escalate before continuing

cycle_phases: create or update that item's lifecycle packet
run RedCap gate; dispatch Kimi and Claude Code when required
execute the item with a changed-reality target
run item verification plus runtime/bin/redcap check
merge Prism review when the item is structural, high-risk, completion-facing, or old-RedCap-derived
resolve every concern or block by accept, reject-with-bounded-rebuttal, or escalate
advance the queue only when the item has verified changed reality or an explicit no-promote decision

kernel_verification_protocol.fresh_probe_rule: Every kernel-verification queue item after kernel-runtime-boundary-verified must re-run at least the verification command(s) named on that item and save item-specific output before advancement.
kernel_verification_protocol.aggregate_check_role: runtime/bin/redcap check is a follow-up guard, not a replacement for the item-specific probe.
kernel_verification_protocol.final_claim_exclusion: This protocol does not authorize redcap-1.0-final-claim.

prism.trigger: run RedCap-owned Prism rule review at every item intake; dispatch both providers when the gate returns required
triage_rules: blocks-this-item prevents the current item from advancing
blocks-1.0 prevents the final 1.0 exit claim
valid-observation-recorded may create a future candidate, but does not block the item or 1.0 by itself
needs-norven-decision is used only for value-laden, irreversible, identity-affecting, release-facing, secret, provider-policy, destructive migration, or evidence-insufficient choices
ambiguous concern triage after one additional cycle escalates to Norven instead of extending debate

queue.changed_reality: The 1.0 loop exists as a bounded contract, short runbook, and redcap check-covered validator.
Report-as-progress pathology is extracted and consumed into an executable guardrail, contract rule, checker, or explicit no-promote decision.
Receipt-as-completion pathology is extracted and consumed into an executable guardrail, contract rule, checker, or explicit no-promote decision.
Closeout-recursion pathology is extracted and consumed into an executable guardrail, contract rule, checker, or explicit no-promote decision.
Raw-evidence-default pathology is extracted and consumed into an executable guardrail, contract rule, checker, or explicit no-promote decision.
A trace test proves Hook Adapter Contract -> Session Ownership Kernel -> Minimal FSM Kernel -> Completion Semantics Validator using only new workspace artifacts.
verification: assert no old RedCap module path is imported

queue.changed_reality: Runtime boundary kernel has an executable probe and passes it.
Session ownership kernel has an executable probe and passes it.
Minimal FSM kernel has executable transition probes and passes them.
Codex hook adapter contract has live marker and action-evidence probes and passes them.
Completion semantics guard rejects proof-only, plan-only, proposal-only, and documentation-only completion claims.
Knowledge gateway v1 has index-first and write-review probes and passes them.
Prism integration has gate, dispatcher, concern-resolution, and ledger probes and passes them.
All 1.0 exit criteria are proven by current-state evidence, then Cap may leave the loop and mark the active goal complete.
verification: final Prism completion review passes or all concerns are resolved

exit_criteria: Every queue item before redcap-1.0-final-claim is verified, no-promote, or explicitly out-of-scope with evidence.
No extract-and-consume item is completed by extraction, summary, ledger, report, closeout, closure, or Prism review alone.
The end-to-end trace test passes and asserts no old RedCap module path import.
The seven 1.0 kernel verification items each have their own executable probe evidence.
All Prism concerns scoped as blocks-this-item or blocks-1.0 are resolved.
Human-gated decisions are either not needed for 1.0 or explicitly resolved by Norven.
